title: Line Art Animation
tagline: Elegant ink-on-paper animated line-art: procedural walk cycles, architectural street scenes, and fluid day-to-night transitions.
description: Hand-drawn Japanese and European ink line-art aesthetic. Crisp SVG path rendering, constant hairline pen weights (1.5–2.5px), animated gait solvers, architectural backgrounds, and atmospheric time-of-day palettes.
